messages:
alice_acme: Hi team — after I SSO into console and switch to Project 'acme-prod' the UI immediately shows 'You do not have permission to view this page'. I was an admin yesterday. API calls with my token still work (GET /v1/projects/acme-prod) but Settings/actions are disabled.
Steps to repro: 1) Sign in via Okta 2) Click org > switch to 'acme-prod' 3) Click Settings > Members. Error shown.
Link to screenshot: https://acme.screens/perm-drop.png

laura_support: thanks for reporting, alice. Can you paste the id_token claims (redact sub/exp) or a screencap of the token payload? curious if groups/roles claim was truncated. Also sending this to infra for resync checks. :eyes:

alice_acme: pasted stripped claims below (redacted):
```
{"iss":"https://okta.acme/","sub":"[redacted]","email":"alice@acme.com","groups":["acme-users","platform-admins", "lots-of-groups-truncated..."],"roles":[]}
```
I noticed the groups array only has a couple entries, it looked shorter than before.

james_infra: thx. Two quick hypotheses: 1) Okta claim size truncation on the id_token (we saw a SCIM/claim change last week), or 2) our console claim parser dropped extra groups when an attribute rename happened. Can you run a quick curl to the console whoami endpoint with your cookie to show what the control plane saw? e.g.
```
curl -i -H "Cookie: sid=YOUR_SESSION_COOKIE" https://console.redwood.example.com/api/v1/whoami
```
that will show the server-side effective roles we have for your session (redact any tokens).

alice_acme: ran it, response below (redacted):
```
{"email":"alice@acme.com","projects":["acme-prod","acme-staging"],"effective_roles":{"acme-prod":[]}}
```
So the effective role for acme-prod is empty.

sam_engineer: this matches a recent claim-normalization deploy (2024-11-02) that strips groups beyond a 4096 char combined attribute, and then maps groups -> project roles. If your Okta groups list exceeds that limit the post-login token will be trimmed and our role mapping returns no bindings. Short-term workaround: reassign a project-specific role to the user directly in the Organization > Members UI (requires an existing admin to do so), or use a service API key to perform critical actions.

laura_support: I'll open an internal incident and request an expedited SCIM/claim resync for acme. Prod bot creating ticket.

prod_bot: Incident created: INC-1234 — "Project access dropped after Okta claim trim". Assigned: eng-infra, priority P1. :rotating_light:

james_infra: action items for us:
- Check if Okta recently changed the group attribute to include a long membership blob (SCIM bulk update) and whether id_token length increased.
- If claim trim happened, we can: a) increase console claim size limit (short-term), b) move to group-ref mapping via SCIM (long-term).
- For now we'll run a manual group sync for acme org and re-evaluate role bindings. @sam_engineer can you run the resync and post logs.

sam_engineer: kicking off manual resync: `adminctl scim resync --org acme --force` — I'll paste progress.

sam_engineer: resync started... parsing 4.8k group entries, hitting a rate throttle on Okta API, continuing in batches. Current status: 48%.

laura_support: alice, while we do this you can try a quick workaround: Open a private browser session and accept an org invite (if another admin sends one) or have an org admin temporarily add you via console > Members > Add member. That will create a local binding that bypasses the trimmed claim mapping.

alice_acme: an admin was able to add me manually — I regained admin rights. Thanks. Please keep me posted on the root fix.

james_infra: resync completed. Logs:
```
[2024-11-12T14:02:10Z] scim: fetch groups, count=4821
[2024-11-12T14:02:45Z] scim: groups normalized, truncated claims detected for 163 users
[2024-11-12T14:03:05Z] roles: remapped 149 role bindings, applied diffs to acme-prod
[2024-11-12T14:03:22Z] scim: success
```

sam_engineer: root cause: Okta changed to return a combined groups claim in id_token which exceeded our internal parse limit; our normalization logic silently dropped the extra groups instead of falling back to SCIM lookups. Patch ready: adjust parser to stream-append groups and fallback to SCIM for >4k char claims. Deploying to prod canary now.

laura_support: closing the support thread after confirm with customer.

alice_acme: confirmed everything is back to normal. Appreciate the fast help. :heart:
